usedFor: Advogalia holds a law office's clients and cases, and Sangam CRM receives a sales lead through “Create Opportunity”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Advogalia, then “Create Opportunity” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A client added in Advogalia becomes an opportunity with a follow-up date, so sales sees it right away.

watchOut: “New Deadline” in Advogalia also fires for hearings and tasks, so pick the trigger before you create opportunities from it.
